confidence.description: Optional reporter confidence; samples below config min_confidence are ignored (hold)

message_id.description: Idempotency key; unique per source; duplicates are acknowledged without effect

observed_at.description: Unix epoch seconds (UTC); freshness is judged against the plane's trusted clock

seq.description: Per-source monotonic sequence; older-or-equal seq is out of order

source.description: Reporter identity; must equal the authenticated principal's source binding

x-compatibility: Adding an optional field or an x- extension is non-breaking (minor). Removing/renaming a field, tightening a range, or changing units is breaking and requires a new major schema id (/2).
x-extension-rule: Top-level keys beginning with 'x-' are non-critical extensions and are ignored; any other unknown key is a critical extension and is rejected (E_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN_CRITICAL).
